#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long powMod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long ans = 1, d = a;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = ans * d % MOD;
        b >>= 1;
        d = d * d % MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

vector<long long> fac, inv;

long long getC(int n, int m) {
    return fac[n] * inv[m] % MOD * inv[n - m] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n = 200001;
    fac.resize(n);
    inv.resize(n);
    fac[0] = inv[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % MOD;
        inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * powMod(i, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    }

    cin >> n;
    long long k;
    cin >> k;
    if (k >= n) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fac[n] << '\n';
        return 0;
    }
    int m = (int)(n - k);
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
        long long term = getC(m, i) * powMod(m - i, n) % MOD;
        if (i % 2 == 0) {
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            ans = (ans - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }
    long long result = 2 * fac[n] % MOD * inv[n - m] % MOD * ans % MOD * inv[m] % MOD;
    cout << result << '\n';

    return 0;
}
